fields.FIR_Description: As per the preliminary report recorded on 2026-06-12, a series of small debits adding up to Rs. 2,40,000 appeared in the statement of the complainant without any authorisation. The time of the incident was given as 10:35 on 2026-06-07. Anand Natarajan submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000327. Gunasekar Anand (9000000050), described as a friend of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Sathish Ramasamy, using the number 9000000209. The account reference SYN-ACC-100091 was noted in connection with the payment. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Potentially relevant material referenced includes digital documents and mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Multiple small transfers reportedly made in quick succession.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, associate, mobile number, phone records, digital document, receiving account, morning
